open_questions.question: Why does the neural-only network settle into a fixed depolarised state? At the ledger defaults (wiring=cook, strengths at the range log-midpoint) 206 of 302 neurons sit above -20 mV at 6 s with transmitter signs (D7) and 100 with receptor_sign on (D8, Fenyves first). Localised to recurrent chemical excitation (isolated cells rest at -53 to -56 mV); receptor-level inhibition halves it but does not remove it.
open_questions.candidates: per-EM synapse strength (range B4 is inferred from circuit models, not measured); the graded release curve (Vth -20 mV, delta 5 mV, BAAIWorm's fit); per-EM gap strength (range C4 guessed); missing extrasynaptic and neuromodulatory inhibition (layers off in these runs)
open_questions.status: open; nothing tuned. The closed loop runs on D8's configuration, labelled. Section 5: four single range ends each bring it under 30 (chemical strength 0.1 nS, excitatory reversal -10 mV, excitatory release slope 2 mV, inhibitory release threshold -45 mV); none has a measured value for or against it (RANGE_ENDS_LIT.md, section 6a). With the excitatory reversal range widened to +11 mV (measured) the template is +0.5 mV and the count is 105 (D8b)

mechanisms.source: Cook et al. 2019 SI 5 (data/worm/structure); BAAIWorm b99ca5a (Zhao et al. 2024 Nat Comput Sci) config2detailed
mechanisms.notes: Default cook since 5 Nov (port302c passed G1-G3 as pre-registered, docs/worm/BRAIN_PORT.md section 3; it saturated more than baaiworm on the old templates: 188 vs 141 neurons above -20 mV at 6 s; see open_questions: saturation). BAAIWorm's neuron-neuron counts (SI5-302.xlsx) equal Cook 2019 exactly (3709 chemical pairs, 20965 synapses; 1091 gap pairs; checked 5 Nov), but its construction places a site on only 2306 chemical and 599 gap pairs (single-synapse pairs round to 0 sites; other pairs have no neurite contact within 1 um). Its neuron-muscle table is its own (552 binary pairs, 76 motor neurons; 337 are Cook edges, Cook has 956 pairs from 162 neurons) and it adds 175 muscle-to-neuron feedback synapses that are not anatomical (Cook has none; the sens_proprio layer covers proprioception). wiring=cook uses Cook for all of it: BAAIWorm's sites where it placed any, else one site on the nearest segment pair

Fenyves calls 436 pairs complex (both signs; our rule used)

mechanisms.name: Gap junctions as innexin channels: conductance per EM contact = open channels x innexin unitary conductance (one shared value; no per-innexin measurement found); no junction where a partner expresses no innexin in CeNGEN. wiring=cook neuron-neuron gaps only.
